# ticker_pitch: Correct the documented behavior against pinned implementation

## Barrier and evidence

The generated README promises note names. display.py:1095 installs FMT_MIDI_HZ, so MIDI 69 formats as 440; the distinct ticker_notes function at display.py:1077 installs FMT_MIDI_NOTE. The README confuses the two API semantics.

Source: `source/mir_eval/display.py:1095`. Native category: `runtime`.

```text
AssertionError: Expected 'A' in formatted MIDI 69, got 440
```
